seg=current_frame.segmentation

    if n['color'] in ('M','P','O','Y') and n['pixels']<40:

print('swap:',res['board_changed'],res['level_completed'])
seg2=current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg2['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ('W','G','O') and n['pixels']>=10:
        b=n['boundary']; rows=[q[0] for q in b]; cols=[q[1] for q in b]
        print(n['color'],n['pixels'],'center~',(round(sum(rows)/len(rows),1),round(sum(cols)/len(cols),1)))
pts=[]
for n in seg2['nodes']:
    if n['color']=='w':
        b=n['boundary']; rows=[q[0] for q in b]; cols=[q[1] for q in b]
        pts.append((min(rows),min(cols),max(rows),max(cols)))
pts.sort()
print('w bboxes:',pts)
</parameter>
</function>
